title: Measures in Community Healthcare System to Help Identify and Support Children and Young Persons Affected by Adverse Childhood Experiences
what_it_is: Measures in Community Healthcare System to Help Identify and Support Children and Young Persons Affected by Adverse Childhood Experiences

sections.label: Mental health programmes for children
sections.summary: IMH, KKH, and community services provide programmes for youth affected by ACEs, and clinicians are trained to spot signs and refer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Institute of Mental Health's (IMH's) programme on Forensic Rehabilitation, Intervention, Evaluation and Network Development Services, or FRIENDS for short, provides integrated multidisciplinary assessment and intervention for youth victims of abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: IMH also conducts a Resilience Programme which enhances the well-being and resilience of children whose parents have mental illnesses, through family-based psycho-education workshops.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Additionally, children with signs of exposure to ACEs may be identified when they present at the KK Women's and Children's Hospital (KKH).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: KKH has two programmes to support children with ACEs.

Community mental health services, such as Youth Community Outreach Teams or CREST-Youth, and Youth Integrated Teams or YITs, also provide mental health support to youths with mental health needs arising from stressors, such as ACEs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In terms of ensuring that healthcare professionals are adequately trained to recognise and address ACE; and in terms of partnership existing between schools and social services to provide comprehensive mental health support for the children, would the Ministry consider implementing screening for ACE in clinics to identify at-risk children early, prior to them coming into the programmes that are already available in the system?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There is already training for our healthcare providers and clinicians to look out for signs and symptoms of ACEs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: When the clinicians see these signs and symptoms, like distress and parental neglect, they can ask more questions and identify some of the issues and would already make the appropriate referrals.

sections.label: Upstream approach with MSF and MOE
sections.summary: The direction is to go as upstream as possible, with MSF and MOE building stronger families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, that is the direction we are going.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We try and go as upstream as possible with MSF and MOE taking care of building stronger families.
